def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items_all = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # --- Только заказы, совершённые до seed_time ---
    orders_past = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time].copy()

    # --- Только позиции заказов, известных до seed_time (ts = момент покупки заказа) ---
    items = order_items_all[order_items_all['ts'] < seed_time].copy()

    items = items.merge(
        orders_past[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_status',
                     'order_approved_at', 'order_delivered_carrier_date',
                     'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date']],
        on='order_id',
        how='inner'
    )

    # Временные разницы учитываем только если событие уже произошло к seed_time
    known_delivered = items['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & (items['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)
    known_approved = items['order_approved_at'].notna() & (items['order_approved_at'] < seed_time)
    known_carrier = items['order_delivered_carrier_date'].notna() & (items['order_delivered_carrier_date'] < seed_time)

    items['delivery_days'] = np.where(
        known_delivered,
        (items['order_delivered_customer_date'] - items['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )
    items['approval_days'] = np.where(
        known_approved,
        (items['order_approved_at'] - items['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )
    items['estimate_diff'] = np.where(
        known_delivered,
        (items['order_delivered_customer_date'] - items['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )
    items['carrier_days'] = np.where(
        known_carrier,
        (items['order_delivered_carrier_date'] - items['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )
    items['is_delivered'] = known_delivered.astype(int)
    items['is_approved'] = known_approved.astype(int)
    items['late_estimate'] = (known_delivered & (items['estimate_diff'] > 0)).astype(int)

    # --- Отзывы: только уже созданные к seed_time ---
    reviews_past = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    if not reviews_past.empty:
        reviews_past = reviews_past.assign(positive=(reviews_past['review_score'] >= 4).astype(int))
        review_agg = reviews_past.groupby('order_id').agg(
            review_mean=('review_score', 'mean'),
            review_count=('review_score', 'size'),
            pos_review_ratio=('positive', 'mean')
        )
        review_agg['has_review'] = 1.0
    else:
        review_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['review_mean', 'review_count', 'pos_review_ratio', 'has_review'])

    # --- Платежи: только известные к seed_time (ts = момент покупки) ---
    payments_past = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time]
    if not payments_past.empty:
        payments_past = payments_past.assign(is_credit=(payments_past['payment_type'] == 'credit_card').astype(int))
        payment_agg = payments_past.groupby('order_id').agg(
            total_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            payment_count=('payment_value', 'size'),
            avg_payment=('payment_value', 'mean'),
            total_installments=('payment_installments', 'sum'),
            avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
            credit_ratio=('is_credit', 'mean')
        )
    else:
        payment_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['total_payment', 'payment_count', 'avg_payment',
                                            'total_installments', 'avg_installments', 'credit_ratio'])

    items = items.merge(review_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    items = items.merge(payment_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    # --- Агрегация по паре (product_id, order_id) ---
    order_product = items.groupby(['product_id', 'order_id']).agg(
        n_items=('order_item_id', 'size'),
        total_price=('price', 'sum'),
        total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        order_purchase_timestamp=('order_purchase_timestamp', 'first'),
        delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'first'),
        approval_days=('approval_days', 'first'),
        carrier_days=('carrier_days', 'first'),
        estimate_diff=('estimate_diff', 'first'),
        is_delivered=('is_delivered', 'first'),
        is_approved=('is_approved', 'first'),
        late_estimate=('late_estimate', 'first'),
        review_mean=('review_mean', 'first'),
        review_count=('review_count', 'first'),
        has_review=('has_review', 'first'),
        pos_review_ratio=('pos_review_ratio', 'first'),
        total_payment=('total_payment', 'first'),
        payment_count=('payment_count', 'first'),
        avg_payment=('avg_payment', 'first'),
        total_installments=('total_installments', 'first'),
        avg_installments=('avg_installments', 'first'),
        credit_ratio=('credit_ratio', 'first')
    ).reset_index()

    # --- Агрегация по product_id ---
    features = order_product.groupby('product_id').agg(
        n_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        sum_total_price=('total_price', 'sum'),
        avg_total_price=('total_price', 'mean'),
        sum_total_freight=('total_freight', 'sum'),
        avg_total_freight=('total_freight', 'mean'),
        avg_n_items=('n_items', 'mean'),
        max_n_items=('n_items', 'max'),
        avg_avg_price=('avg_price', 'mean'),
        std_avg_price=('avg_price', 'std'),
        avg_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'mean'),
        std_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'std'),
        avg_approval_days=('approval_days', 'mean'),
        avg_carrier_days=('carrier_days', 'mean'),
        avg_estimate_diff=('estimate_diff', 'mean'),
        delivered_ratio=('is_delivered', 'mean'),
        approved_ratio=('is_approved', 'mean'),
        late_estimate_ratio=('late_estimate', 'mean'),
        avg_review_mean=('review_mean', 'mean'),
        sum_review_count=('review_count', 'sum'),
        avg_has_review=('has_review', 'mean'),
        avg_pos_review_ratio=('pos_review_ratio', 'mean'),
        avg_total_payment=('total_payment', 'mean'),
        sum_total_payment=('total_payment', 'sum'),
        avg_payment_count=('payment_count', 'mean'),
        avg_avg_payment=('avg_payment', 'mean'),
        avg_total_installments=('total_installments', 'mean'),
        avg_avg_installments=('avg_installments', 'mean'),
        avg_credit_ratio=('credit_ratio', 'mean')
    )

    # --- Продавцы: только по прошлым позициям ---
    seller_agg = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
        n_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
        n_seller_items=('seller_id', 'size')
    )
    features = features.join(seller_agg, how='left')

    # --- Временные признаки ---
    times = order_product.groupby('product_id')['order_purchase_timestamp'].agg(
        last_order_ts='max',
        first_order_ts='min',
        total_orders='count'
    )

    times['days_since_last_order'] = (seed_time - times['last_order_ts']).dt.days
    times['days_since_first_order'] = (seed_time - times['first_order_ts']).dt.days
    times['order_span_days'] = (times['last_order_ts'] - times['first_order_ts']).dt.days
    times['order_freq_per_month'] = np.where(
        times['order_span_days'] > 0,
        times['total_orders'] / (times['order_span_days'] / 30.0),
        0.0
    )

    for days in [30, 60, 90, 180]:
        threshold = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
        recent = order_product[order_product['order_purchase_timestamp'] > threshold].groupby('product_id').size()
        times[f'recent_{days}_orders'] = recent.reindex(times.index).fillna(0).astype(int)

    features = features.join(times.drop(columns=['last_order_ts', 'first_order_ts']), how='left')

    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    features = features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)
    return features
